businesses.business: Industrial engineering and product lifecycle software

offering_description.value: PTC sells engineering, product lifecycle and field service software to manufacturers and other organizations that design, build or maintain complex products. It develops the software and delivers it through cloud subscriptions and customer-managed deployments.

primary_products.value: Computer-aided design software; product lifecycle management software; application lifecycle management software; service lifecycle management software; industrial augmented reality software

customer_segment.value: B2B: Manufacturers, engineering firms, defense contractors and equipment service organizations; B2G: Government defense and engineering organizations

end_markets.value: Industrial machinery; aerospace and defense; automotive; electronics; medical devices

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring access to cloud and customer-managed engineering and service software; service fees: Implementation consulting and training

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Develops tools that manage design files, product records and service data for manufacturers and engineering teams; service provider: Uses its software expertise to help manufacturers implement systems and train users

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Product design, product data management, software development lifecycle, field service and augmented reality

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise sales teams serving manufacturers and other large organizations; partners / resellers: Value-added resellers and systems integrators; online: Self-service subscriptions for cloud-based design software

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Cloud services are subject to data privacy rules, and software exports are subject to U.S. export controls.
